rows.definition: The agent.StreamingPlanner that serves chat turns on the dedicated inkling2_loop forward: it renders the request with the Inkling-2 chat template, tokenizes it, caps prompt plus completion at the context budget, drives an Inkling2LoopGenerator and lifts tool calls from the output. NewInkling2LoopPlanner builds it; fak serve holds it as inkling2Planner.
rows.distinction: A CHAT-TURN planner in the agent sense (request in, assistant message out), not a memory, fit or run plan: it allocates nothing and prices nothing. It exists because inkling2_loop has no *model.Model and so cannot ride InKernelPlanner.

rows.definition: The gateway.Config field carrying a ready agent.Planner for a local model that has no *model.Model (today the inkling2_loop forward). When set and no proxy upstream is configured, the gateway uses it as the chat planner ahead of InKernelModel.
rows.distinction: A CONFIG SLOT selecting which planner serves chat, not a planner implementation: it holds whatever planner fak serve built, and is ignored in proxy mode.

rows.definition: One request's greedy decode state over a fresh inkling2_loop KV cache: Prefill consumes the prompt and returns the next token, Step consumes one token and returns the next, Close frees it. NewInkling2LoopSession opens the resident CUDA-graph session when the backend qualifies, else the host-driven one.
rows.distinction: A PER-REQUEST decode state, not an agent, chat or user session: it carries no conversation identity and dies with the request. A resident session is bound to the OS thread that first steps it.

rows.definition: model.Config predicate: true when a generically decoded config's model_type is the inkling2_loop envelope or text type, so serve, the planner and the renderer can route the family to its dedicated forward.
rows.distinction: A FAMILY IDENTITY check on config, not a loop control: it iterates nothing and reports no pass count.

rows.definition: Maps an inkling2_loop GGUF exactly like OpenInkling2Loop, then moves its packed weights onto a compute.Backend and installs the device batcher so the forward runs on the GPU.
rows.distinction: A DEVICE-RESIDENT open of the model weights, not a session open: it opens no KV cache and decodes nothing; sessions come from NewInkling2LoopSession on the returned model.

rows.definition: Port of the Inkling-2 GGUF tokenizer.chat_template: renders messages and tool definitions into the prompt string, ending on the last closed block because the model writes its own message header.
rows.distinction: A PROMPT TEXT renderer for one model family, not a UI, markdown or materialized-view render: its output is tokenized, never displayed.
